aad: chunk 0: header || aad. Every other chunk: aad.

cases.name: one byte over a chunk, zstd flag
cases.plaintext_seed: file-stream/one byte over a chunk, zstd flag

cases.name: two chunks and a short last one, zstd flag
cases.plaintext_seed: file-stream/two chunks and a short last one, zstd flag

keys: enc_key = HKDF-SHA256(key, info = label_enc || salt), commitment = HKDF-SHA256(key, info = label_commit || salt), 32 bytes, no salt
layout: header(70) = version(1) suite(1) flags(1) key_id(8) chunk_size(4, big endian) salt(16) nonce_prefix(7) commitment(32); then chunks of chunk_size bytes + tag(16); the last chunk is 1 to chunk_size bytes (0 only for an empty stream)

must_fail.name: a chunk appended after the last
a middle chunk in place of the last
a changed byte in the first chunk
a changed byte in a middle chunk
a changed tag in the last chunk
the zstd flag set by hand
a chunk size of 2048 in the header

nonce: nonce_prefix(7) || counter(4, big endian, from 0) || last(1): 0x00, or 0x01 for the last chunk
plaintext: SHA-256 of "<plaintext_seed>/<n>" for n = 0, 1, 2 ... joined and cut to plaintext_bytes
